name: half kneeling side lunge
description: From a half kneeling position you shift your weight sideways to open the hips and inner thigh. It builds hip mobility.
instructions: Start in a half kneeling position with one knee down and the other foot forward.
Turn your front foot out to the side.
Shift your hips sideways toward the straight leg.
Keep your chest up and feel the inner thigh open.
Return to the center with control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
